seed_fact: Don't switch platforms mid-business-launch. Migrate during a slow month to minimize disruption.
caption:
Thinking about moving from Wix to WordPress? Changing platforms while sales peak can stall orders and confuse customers. Schedule the migration in a quiet month so the transition is seamless and you keep momentum. DM me to plan a smooth website switch that protects your business.
